name: bodegon-digital
description: Bodegón Digital — monorepo: núcleo de negocio compartido (packages/core), web (web/, Vite + TS) y app móvil (mobile/, Expo).

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:web && npm run test:mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bodegon/core && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w mobile
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage -w @bodegon/core && npm run test:web && npm run test:mobile && npm run build:web
